assets.name: 琉璃熊猫摆件
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original isolated game souvenir candidate.
Image 1 is a painting-style reference only; do not reproduce its basket, weaving or object layout.
Subject: one tiny seated panda figurine cast as a unified colored-glass sculpture. It has a plump milky-white, nearly clear glass body, translucent smoky-black round ears, two readable eye patches and four limbs. Add restrained pale aqua-green rim light, two or three clean highlights, and gentle broad internal refraction. Make the smooth, softly luminous glass material unmistakable, rather than fur, stone, ceramic or plastic. Show the whole seated silhouette in three-quarter front view. Do not add bamboo, packaging, a pedestal or a separate base.
Style: warm, fresh two-dimensional hand-painted game art, light deep-brown outlines, complete broad color areas, and only one or two simple shadow/highlight layers per surface. Keep the handmade softness without dense flecks, paper grain, stains, random scratches, photorealistic detail or rendered 3D.
Output: one NEW 1024x1024 square PNG. Center the complete subject at approximately 75% of the canvas with safe empty margins on every side. Use genuine transparent alpha outside the object; never draw a checkerboard or opaque background. No floor, scene, display card, collage, text, logo or watermark.
